# A hook must work on every path through the routine it patches

A special job can skip the setup a hook relies on. The E-M1 III Sharpness hook restarted the camera with HDR.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M1 Mark III firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/em1-iii-1600.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M1 Mark III](../cameras/em1-iii.md)

In E-M1 III 1.6 the sharpening routine has an early exit for special jobs, which HDR takes after the shutter release. That exit skips setting a stack slot that the linear Sharpness stub read. The fix returns at once when there is no gain to scale. Check each caller and early exit of a hooked routine, not only the normal path.

> **What happens:** Camera reboot whenever HDR fires, at any Sharpness value.

**Symptoms:** [Restarts or crashes when a feature runs](index.md#restart-in-use)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([E-M1 Mark III Mod Builder](../projects/em1-iii-mod-builder.md)): The patch tool's notes trace the reboot to the early-out path, which leaves the slot the stub read unset. Source: [E-M1 III linear Sharpness patch tool](../sources/em1m3.sharp-off.md).
- **Physical camera** ([E-M1 Mark III Mod Builder](../projects/em1-iii-mod-builder.md)): The author's mod list of 2026-11-24 says the HDR reboot is fixed and camera-tested. Source: [E-M1 III mod pack](../sources/em1m3.mods.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/dfeldt91-blip/E-M1-Miii/blob/64ebb28d23e4d5aa11d3350774aa9c76a137fea0/tools/patch_sharp_off.py)**
